alex: Quick sync: we need to change how route labeling is stored in telemetry. Plan is to add a route_label_id FK and a compact route_labels table, then backfill. Anyone see major console/query hazards?

maya: @alex can we dual-write (old enum + new FK) for 2w and then backfill? main worry is dashboards that group_by the old tag value.

sandeep: Dual-write is safest. Also watch cardinality — if teams start creating freeform labels we blow up indexes. Suggest: route_labels table with (id, canonical_label, fingerprint) and a mapping job that dedups during backfill.

jeff: Avoid big in-place UPDATEs on console_events. My preferred approach: shadow table + bulk populate via COPY, then rename. That limits locks.

alex: :thumbsup: Good call. How do we keep reads consistent during the swap? Console reads are everywhere.

maya: We can add a read adapter behind a feature flag. New code reads from a view that prefers route_label_id and falls back to the old tag text. Canary the flag per-tenant.

sandeep: Example view (pseudo-SQL):

```
-- create compact labels
CREATE TABLE route_labels (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, canonical text, fingerprint bigint);
-- view that hides migration complexity
CREATE VIEW console_event_with_label AS
SELECT e.*, coalesce(rl.canonical, e.route_tag) AS route_label
FROM console_events e
LEFT JOIN route_labels rl ON e.route_label_id = rl.id;
```

Backfill can stream: dump event ids -> chunked jobs -> INSERT INTO route_labels (SELECT dedup(...)) -> UPDATE console_events SET route_label_id = mapping WHERE id IN (chunk). Keep chunks small (100k).

jeff: For swapping, do: create view name, deploy backend to use view, enable feature flag for canary tenants, monitor. If something breaks, flip flag back — no table rename required.

ops-bot: migration-bot: started backfill job tenant=42 chunk=1/200

alex: TL;DR rollout plan: 1) dual-write for 2w, 2) run deduping backfill job in shadow mode, 3) create view + deploy read-adapter, 4) enable flag for 2-3 canary tenants, 5) monitor 95p query latency and dashboard deltas, 6) enable more tenants over days. Rollback: flip flag off, keep dual-write for 30d, and pause backfill. I'll draft a short runbook and attach to the migration PR.

maya: Add alerts: console query 95p > baseline + 30% and increased DB write IO. Also consider a metric for "label-cardinality-per-tenant" so we can gate paced backfills.

sandeep: One more: ensure dedupe mapping is idempotent and include a tombstone for deleted labels so we don't re-create ghost labels during retries.

alex: Great — I'll open the PR with the SQL + runbook. Thanks all.
